title: Patient Payment Plans Schedule of Financial-Class Credits on Re-Spread Installments
content:
A re-spread installment of an active Patient Payment Plans plan carries a class credit set by the financial class of the patient's Patient Financial Account.

| Financial class of the Patient Financial Account | Class credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Self-Pay Account | 3.00 |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 2.00 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 0.00 |
| Medicare Part B Account | 0.00 |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 0.00 |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 0.00 |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 0.00 |

**Schedule rule.** The class credit on the re-spread installment is 3.00 on the Self-Pay Account, 2.00 on the High-Deductible Health Plan Account, and 0.00 on every other class. The credit is subtracted from the spread of the plan balance; the re-spread installment is never below the tier's minimum installment and is rounded half up to the cent.

**Record read.** The financial class recorded on the Patient Financial Account.

**Figure (hypothetical).** A spread of 201.56 on the Self-Pay Account: 201.56 less 3.00 is 198.56.
